definitions.explanation: The dark part of the day, from sunset until dawn.

examples.english: What do you do at night?

examples.japanese: {毎晩|まいばん}{夜|よる}10{時|じ}に{寝|ね}ます。
examples.english: I go to bed at 10 o'clock every night.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}の{夜|よる}は{忙|いそが}しかったです。

notes:
{夜|よる} is the primary word for night, covering the period from sunset to dawn.

TIME OF DAY SEQUENCE:
- {朝|あさ}: morning
- {昼|ひる}: daytime/noon
- {夕方|ゆうがた}: evening
- {夜|よる}: night

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {夜|よる}ごはん/{晩|ばん}ごはん: dinner
- {今夜|こんや}: tonight
- {昨夜|さくや}/{ゆうべ}: last night
- {毎晩|まいばん}: every night
- {夜中|よなか}: midnight, middle of the night
- {夜遅|よるおそ}く: late at night

COMPOUNDS:
- {夜行|やこう}バス: overnight bus
- {夜景|やけい}: night view
- {夜勤|やきん}: night shift

CONTRAST WITH {晩|ばん}:
{夜|よる} refers to night generally; {晩|ばん} often refers specifically to evening/dinnertime.
